# AurevyxOnline

> AurevyxOnline is a human-first digital growth agency based in Patna, Bihar, India, serving businesses across India.

## Website
- https://www.aurevyx.online/

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.aurevyx.online/): Digital growth agency overview.
- [About](https://www.aurevyx.online/about.html): Agency background, approach and values.
- [Services](https://www.aurevyx.online/services.html): Website development, SEO, performance marketing, video editing, content creation, branding, WhatsApp and email marketing, and UI/UX design.
- [Why choose us](https://www.aurevyx.online/why-us.html): Working principles, communication and pricing approach.
- [Our work](https://www.aurevyx.online/work.html): Creative portfolio and concept previews. Portfolio visuals are illustrative concepts, not claimed client case studies or measured results.
- [Testimonials](https://www.aurevyx.online/testimonials.html): Client experience and collaboration approach. This page describes service expectations and does not publish fabricated customer reviews.
- [Contact](https://www.aurevyx.online/contact.html): Contact and project enquiries.
